title: Night Visit to the Hidden Pavilion
next_chapter_hook: The masked figure lifted a corner of his veil, revealing a face bearing some resemblance to Chen Ji's. His voice was low and hoarse: "My name is Chen Ming, a fellow disciple of Chen Tianming."

text.content: The candlelight in the Eastern Palace's side hall flickered unstably. The Crown Prince's voice echoed through the empty great hall. Chen Ji stood with downcast eyes, his expression still one of servile timidity, yet only the slightly tightened fist hidden in his sleeve betrayed a hint of his true emotions. The Crown Prince needed him? Hmph, how interesting. All the world's bustle is driven by profit. What the Crown Prince coveted was never Chen Ji himself, but what he could bring.

dialogue.content: Your Highness's generosity overwhelms your subject. But I am merely a menial servant—how could I possibly...

text.content: Before he could finish, hurried footsteps rang outside the hall. A black-clothed shadow guard appeared soundlessly at the doorway, holding an unsigned letter. The Crown Prince frowned and gestured for the guard to hand the letter to Chen Ji. As Chen Ji took the letter, his fingertips brushing the seal, a faint spiritual energy fluctuation made his pupils contract sharply—the letter had been tampered with, and the method was extremely covert. Had he not spent years dealing with the Tianji Record, he would have been hard-pressed to detect it.

dialogue.content: (Opening the letter, his expression normal, yet his heart already churning like a tempest)...Midnight, the Ancient Pavilion outside the city. Awaiting your presence.

text.content: The letter contained only a few sparse characters, the brushstrokes sharp as swords, the handwriting exuding an air of looking down upon the world. Chen Ji tucked the letter into his sleeve and took his leave of the Crown Prince. His gait remained steady, as if nothing had occurred. But in his mind, he was already racing through possibilities—this letter's arrival was far too suspicious, the timing too precise, as if someone had long calculated that he would appear at the Eastern Palace tonight.

The night was deep as ink. Chen Ji left the Tianqing Sect without a sound, his form like a specter threading through layers of夜雾. The Ancient Pavilion outside the city lay among ruins, weeds overgrown all around, thick with Yin energy. He knew this place too well—three years ago, he had first activated the Tianji Record Fragment here, and it was also here that he first sensed that gaze of Heavenly Will.

dialogue.content: (Following at Chen Ji's side, demonic energy suppressed to near invisibility) The atmosphere here is very strange, as if some kind of barrier has been laid. I detect at least three profound spiritual pressures lurking within, each no weaker than me.
Three? (A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips, a glint of amusement flickering in his eyes) Interesting. It seems tonight's game is even more complex than I anticipated.

text.content: The silhouette of the Ancient Pavilion loomed hazily under the moonlight, its mottled walls covered in moss and vines, like a ruin forgotten by time. Yet Chen Ji noticed fine threads of spiritual energy flowing through the air around the pavilion—a highly sophisticated formation, its formation eye hidden so deep that had he not thoroughly studied the formation texts left by Mo Xiansheng, he would never have discovered it.

Chen Ji drew a deep breath and stepped into the Ancient Pavilion. Inside was pitch black, save for a massive Yin-Yang fish pattern carved on the ground at the center, emanating a cold, ghostly glow. Just then, a hoarse voice rang out from the darkness, as if rising from the Nine Abyssal Depths: "You came."

A figure emerged from the shadows, entirely shrouded in a black robe, a black iron mask covering his face, revealing only a pair of deep, profound eyes. Those eyes held no emotion whatsoever, yet inspired a soul-deep oppression. Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but alarm bells rang in his heart—this person's cultivation was unfathomable, far beyond his own.

dialogue.content: (The masked figure stood with hands clasped behind his back, voice coldly indifferent) Chen Ji, Outer Disciple/Servant of the Tianqing Sect, seemingly useless yet calculating without flaw. You think your schemes are flawless, yet from the very beginning, you have been observed by the gaze of a higher existence.
(Chen Ji laughed lightly, utterly fearless) I presume my esteemed guest didn't invite me here merely to state such an obvious truth? Speak plainly, if you please.

text.content: A glimmer of approval flashed in the masked figure's eyes, his voice still ice-cold: "The Keepers of the Game have taken notice of you. Every move you make, every calculation, is under their watchful eyes." He paused, his tone sharpening abruptly, "You should know—the Tianji Record is not the only prophetic secret tome in this world."

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing stepped forward, demonic energy latent but unfurling) The Keepers of the Game? I've never heard this name in the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. Who exactly are you people?

(The masked figure's gaze swept over Ye Qing, seemingly recognizing her) The Holy Maiden of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path? Interesting. It seems Chen Ji's chess game has already extended this far. But tonight's performance is not yours to star in.

text.content: The masked figure raised his hand, injecting a thread of spiritual energy into the Yin-Yang pattern on the ground. In an instant, brilliant light flooded the Ancient Pavilion, and a blurred image emerged above the Yin-Yang fish—a young man's back, standing atop a cliff, before him the abyss of ten thousand zhang. Chen Ji's heart lurched—that back was unmistakably his own!

dialogue.content: This is the calamity you are about to face. The Keepers of the Game have calculated that in three days, you will walk into a death trap. And the only key to breaking the局 lies within the secret you have long pursued.

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, the light in his eyes flickering uncertainly. He recalled what Mo Xiansheng once said—the complete version of the Tianji Record was divided into several parts, scattered across the world. And his father, Chen Tianming, was one of the original holders of the Tianji Record. So were the "Keepers of the Game" mentioned by this person somehow connected to the Tianji Record?

dialogue.content: Your intelligence is indeed surprising, esteemed guest. But... with such crucial information, why share it with me? Surely there is some price Chen Ji must pay?

(The masked figure nodded slightly) You're indeed clever. We can offer you shelter, help you survive the death trap three days from now. But in exchange, you must tell us... where does that Heavenly Fate Mark on your body originate?

text.content: This question was like a blade piercing the most hidden corner of Chen Ji's heart. The Heavenly Fate Mark—that mysterious pattern that had appeared on his body after obtaining the Tianji Record, and also the price of his Foresight Ability. Mo Xiansheng had warned him that this secret must never be told to anyone, lest it bring annihilation. And yet this masked figure actually named it directly.

choice.prompt: The masked figure's question cut to the core. Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Openly admit and exchange for intelligence
choices.description: Honestly reveal the connection between the Heavenly Fate Mark and the Tianji Record, testing how much the other party knows. The risk is exposing one's trump cards, but one might gain more critical information.
choices.visible_cost: Expose part of the core secret
choices.visible_reward: Gain initial trust of the Keepers of the Game and more intelligence about his father Chen Tianming
choices.risk_hint: The other party may already know the answer and merely be testing your sincerity

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's expression unchanged, his tone calm) Since your intelligence is so comprehensive, surely you have some understanding of the Tianji Record? The Heavenly Fate Mark on my body comes precisely from that incomplete secret tome.
(The masked figure's eyes gleamed slightly) As expected of an inheritor of the Tianji Record. Then you should know what the name Chen Tianming signifies.

choices.text: Turn the tables, probe for the truth
choices.description: Rather than answer directly, instead expose the other party's knowledge of Chen Tianming, probing their relationship with your father. The risk is potentially angering them, but gains the initiative.
choices.visible_cost: May forfeit the opportunity to gain intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Force the other party to reveal more information about Chen Tianming
choices.risk_hint: They may consequently withhold further information

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji laughed lightly, answering with a counter-question) Since you mention Chen Tianming, I presume you have some connection with my father? By what name may I address you?
(The masked figure fell silent for a moment, as if studying Chen Ji) You certainly have composure. That trait... is indeed like him.

choices.description: Make no statements whatsoever, letting the other party reveal more of their cards first. The risk is potentially losing their patience, but one can see their true intentions.
choices.visible_cost: May miss a good opportunity to establish a connection
choices.visible_reward: See the other party's bottom line and obtain more complete intelligence
choices.risk_hint: They may therefore leave in anger
choices.process_label: 陈机静静地看着蒙面人……

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He simply stood there, his face betraying no expression whatsoever. His silence was like an invisible shield, deflecting all attempts at probing. The atmosphere in the Ancient Pavilion suddenly froze, and those three lurking spiritual pressures seemed to stir as well.

dialogue.content: (The masked figure sighed softly) You truly are different from him. He was far too impatient back then, which is why he met such an end. Very well, since you don't wish to speak, I'll tell you something else—Chen Tianming was also a member of the Tianji Pavilion.

text.content: These words were like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. The Tianji Pavilion—he had seen this name countless times in the fragments left by Mo Xiansheng, yet never found any substantive records. Mo Xiansheng only said it was a mysterious organization that coexisted with the Tianji Record, its members being prophetic seers throughout the ages, never mentioning that his father had any connection to this organization.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's voice turned slightly hoarse) My father... was a member of the Tianji Pavilion?

Not merely a member. (A barely perceptible sigh crept into the masked figure's voice) He was the youngest candidate for Pavilion Master of the Tianji Pavilion. Had things gone differently, he should have become the next Pavilion Master. Unfortunately... he chose a path of betrayal.

text.content: Betrayal? Chen Ji's fists unconsciously clenched tight. He had always believed his father was murdered, slain by those who coveted the Tianji Record. Never had he imagined his father had such deep ties to the Tianji Pavilion. And the word "betrayal" stirred in his heart a complicated emotion beyond description.
(Ye Qing sensed Chen Ji's emotional turbulence and stepped forward unconsciously) Chen Ji, are you alright?

Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions. His face again wore its usual look of calm, though a hidden gloom now lingered deep in his eyes. Ye Qing saw it, her heart silently sighing—this man was always like this, hiding all his emotions in the deepest places, never allowing anyone to glimpse his vulnerable side.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji raised his eyes, cold, fierce light burning within) Betrayal? What exactly did my father do that made the Tianji Pavilion consider him a traitor?

(The masked figure fell silent for a moment) He attempted to break free from the control of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, wishing to grant all prophetic seers true freedom. In the eyes of the Tianji Pavilion, this was an unforgivable sin. Thus... he was sealed within a Temporal Rift, never to be reborn through the ages.

text.content: Temporal Rift—these four characters made Chen Ji's heart lurch. That was a legendary Deadly Ground where even great powers could not survive. Once sealed within, one would drift forever in endless void, enduring eternal loneliness and torment. Mo Xiansheng had said his fragmented soul survived only because the Tianji Record formed a special barrier. Had it not been for that, he would have long followed his father's fate.

dialogue.content: (The masked figure's voice suddenly dropped low) And now, the Keepers of the Game have taken notice of you. You carry Chen Tianming's bloodline and have inherited his unfinished cause. To the Keepers of the Game, you are a threat, an existence that must be erased.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji faced a difficult choice:

choices.description: Agree to trade the secret of the Heavenly Fate Mark for the protection of the Tianji Pavilion, giving up independent resistance against the Keepers of the Game. Gain temporary safety, but possibly fall under their control.
choices.visible_cost: Lose some degree of autonomy, possibly exploited by the Tianji Pavilion
choices.visible_reward: Gain the protection of the Tianji Pavilion and face the three-day death trap calmly
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Pavilion's motives may not be pure and they may have ulterior motives

dialogue.content: (After a long pause, Chen Ji spoke) If the Tianji Pavilion truly can protect Chen Ji's safety, this condition... might not be entirely unacceptable.
(The masked figure nodded slightly) A wise choice. However, before reaching a final agreement, I have one more condition.

choices.description: Refuse cooperation with the Tianji Pavilion, refusing to change stance even in the face of the Keepers of the Game's threats. Extremely risky, but maintains absolute autonomy.
choices.visible_cost: Face the Keepers of the Game's threats alone; the three-day death trap looks grim
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independence and not be dictated by any faction
choices.risk_hint: At current strength, direct confrontation with the Keepers of the Game offers extremely low odds of victory
choices.process_label: 陈机眼中闪过一丝冷芒……

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji laughed coldly) My fate has never been in anyone else's hands. Be it the Tianji Pavilion or the Keepers of the Game—do they think they can make me a chess piece? They should first ask my chessboard if it agrees.
(A complex light flickered in the masked figure's eyes) ...He truly was your father. Very well, since your mind is made up, I'll gift you one more piece of intelligence as a farewell present.

choices.text: Strategic retreat for advantage, demand more
choices.description: Pretend to accept cooperation while actually demanding more leverage: the exact location of his father's sealing, the possibility of rescuing his father, and more intelligence on the Keepers of the Game.
choices.visible_cost: Expose more trump cards and weaknesses
choices.visible_reward: Gain critical intelligence while maintaining room for maneuvering
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through and fall into a passive position

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji spoke unhurriedly) Cooperation is possible, but I too have several conditions. First, I want to know the exact location where my father was sealed. Second, I want all intelligence on the Keepers of the Game. Third—I wish to know who exactly the Tianji Pavilion are.
(The masked figure was silent for a long while, seemingly weighing options) Your appetite is rather large. But... very well, since we've come this far tonight, I'll let you see clearly.

text.content: The moment his voice faded, the masked figure suddenly raised his hand and slowly removed the black iron mask from his face. Moonlight streamed through the shattered window lattice, illuminating the face hidden for so long—a face weathered and lined with years, its features bearing a resemblance to Chen Ji, save for the furrows time had carved into it.

dialogue.content: (The masked figure's voice low and hoarse, echoing in the silent Ancient Pavilion) My name is Chen Ming, a fellow disciple of Chen Tianming.

text.content: This name was like a heavy hammer, striking Chen Ji's heart. Chen Ming—he had seen this name in his father's fragmentary writings, but never imagined meeting him like this. He stared fixedly at that face so reminiscent of his father's, his fists white-knuckled around the letter, yet not a single word escaped his lips.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing sensed the heavy atmosphere and unconsciously tightened her grip on Chen Ji's wrist) Chen Ji...

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the churning emotions. He raised his eyes to look at the masked man who called himself Chen Ming. The light in his eyes was complex and indecipherable—shock, doubt, anger, and a barely perceptible anticipation all mixed together. Was this sudden apparition friend or foe? And would the truth about his father truly be revealed through him? The night deepened, the atmosphere in the Ancient Pavilion grew increasingly bizarre, and those three unfathomable spiritual pressures still lurked in the shadows, as if ready to explode at any moment.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ming replaced his mask, his voice returning to its former cold indifference) After tonight, the Keepers of the Game will accelerate their pursuit of you. You have three days to consider;届时, someone will come to find you. Until then... make good use of that incomplete Tianji Record in your hands.

text.content: The words fell, and Chen Ming's figure dissolved into the darkness like a specter, vanishing without a trace. The three spiritual pressures within the Ancient Pavilion also dispersed, as if they had never existed. Ye Qing scanned the surroundings, confirming the danger had passed, before finally letting out a breath of relief.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing looked at Chen Ji, her eyes filled with worry) Are you... are you alright? What that Chen Ming said just now, about your father...

(Chen Ji was silent for a long while before finally speaking, his voice somewhat hoarse) I'm fine. It's just... there's too much information from tonight. I need time to process it. Let's go. We'll talk back at the sect.

text.content: Moonlight flowed like water, drenching Chen Ji's departing silhouette. His gait was still steady, his spine still straight, as if nothing had changed. Yet Ye Qing sensed acutely that the hand holding hers tightened slightly, as if silently drawing strength from it. This seemingly invincible man had at last revealed a flicker of human warmth tonight.

Chen Ming's figure remerged into the shadows deep within the Ancient Pavilion. That aged face beneath the mask appeared even more profound under the moonlight. His voice drifted like a wisp of smoke, dispersing in the night wind: "Xiao Ji, I hope you won't walk the same path as your father..." Before the words finished, he had utterly vanished into the darkness. Only the Yin-Yang fish pattern on the Ancient Pavilion floor continued to emanate its ghostly glow, illuminating Chen Ji's slightly heavy departing footsteps.
